evidence.title: Framer Motion Guide (2026): Layout and Reduced Motion

name: Framer Motion Guide (2026)
summary: Guide to the Framer Motion React animation library: primitives, layout animations, exits, bundle size and reduced motion.
description: Article covering Framer Motion's primitives (motion.div, variants, springs, gestures), layout and layoutId animations, AnimatePresence modes, the LazyMotion bundle-size table, when CSS and view transitions win instead, and why reducedMotion defaults to never. Updated September 10, 2026.
contains: comparison of Motion vs GSAP, CSS and React Spring
